_readme: Declared dependency on GitHub Actions secrets. GitHub substitutes the empty string for a secret that does not exist, so an unprovisioned reference fails deep inside a scheduled run instead of at authoring time. tests/invariants/workflow-secret-provisioning.spec.ts pins this file against the workflows. provisioned=false means the workflows referencing it cannot do their credentialed work until an operator provisions it in the listed scope.

ARIA_GH_APP_ID.why: used by aria-readiness-claim.yml, finding-closure-reconcile.yml, finding-state-sweep.yml — GitHub App id for the installation-token mint (docs/runbooks/aria-github-app-setup.md)

ARIA_GH_APP_INSTALLATION_ID.why: used by aria-readiness-claim.yml, finding-closure-reconcile.yml, finding-state-sweep.yml — the GitHub App installation id for the enterprise token lease the readiness claim family attests; the lane fails closed (ARIA_REQUIRE_MODE_A) without it

ARIA_GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.why: used by aria-readiness-claim.yml, finding-closure-reconcile.yml, finding-state-sweep.yml — GitHub App private key PEM content; hosted runners materialize it into an ephemeral 0600 file because the operator runbook's key path only exists on the self-hosted box
